title: “Games are thus the most ancient and time-honored vehicle for education… We don’t see mother lions lecturing cubs at the chalkboard... In light of this, the question, ‘Can games have educational value?’ becomes absurd. It is not games but schools that are the newfangled notion, the untested fad, the violator of tradition.”
